set.body: Found by UI-G0 (2026-09-18): fixation-only input cannot fail a single trial (one frame per CSV, positions checked, positive durations), so the consumer's failed-pair case is a whole scale failing. Add a fixture or input route that fails individual trials (for example a foreign frame or a per-trial invalid bandwidth) so denominators under both failure policies are exercised with mixed success, end to end through save, reload and rerun.
set.title: Partial-failure fixture where some pairs of a scale fail and others succeed
